notes.title: Burning Skies Arcade - Demo Update
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/7243354/040b707d40275c5971df644db46612103b8b95ef.gif

Hello folks, based on your feedback I've worked for the last weeks, on an update for the Burning Skies Arcade Demo, here's what changed:

Improvements/Fetures
 Highscore
 Saving the settings and Hiscore
 A little tutorial at the beggining of the demo
 Feedback when the player picks a power up
 Ajusted audio mastering
New Content
 New Range Power Up
Balancing
 Adjusted the space between projectiles on one of the boss's attacks
Bugfixes
- Wall creation with missing parts
- Audio didn't set to zero
- Glitch when music interlapping
- glitch engine sfx interlapping
- when pausing at the beggining the menu whould not show up
 
Check the free demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290190/Burning_Skies_Arcade/

As aways, thanks for your support, and please join our discord and tell me what do you think of this new update. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802060/ac01faddf114bfe95350f607d1767587e9d027bb.gif


Burning Skies Arcade is a freeware version of Burning Skies, a bigger roguelite shmup that we'll release next year, please wishlist it so you'll receive updates when we have any news

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

notes.title: Cyberhunt Ver. 2.03
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28834532/15171fc99f2047ac411bb1ad47fa1b13a46ea3c8.gif

Hello friends, since the last major update of CYBEHUNT i kept updating and improving the game based on your feedback, here's what  was changed, fixed or added:

LOCALIZATION

 Russian
 Korean


IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES

 Updated some Mission requirements that was broken
 Classic controller options; 
 Improved the analog support so it's not limited to 8 directions
 Fixed game crashes when reaching the final missions;
 Adjusted the missions description HUD to aways be centered;
 Updated controls screen that showed a key for the bomb (wich is not used anymore);
 Now the player can switch to controls and keyboard without the need to change on the options
 Improved the mouse aim, now the ship will only aim to the mouse direction when the player moves the mouse, it avoids the ship to keep rotating on the same spot and allow the screen warp.


Please let me know if you find more issues with the localization or the game itself. 

Thank you very much for the support and feedback. 

Join our discord server if you like what I'm doing and want to keep in touch. 
discord.nukgames.com

notes.title: Cyberhunt Ver. 2.02
notes.content:
Hello friends, due to your feedback I updated the controls for the game, here's what changed.


 Added classic controls options (like the previous version)
 Improved the analog support so it's not limited to 8 directions
 Now the player can switch to controls and keyboard without the need to change on the options
 Improved the mouse aim, now the ship will only aim to the mouse direction when the player moves the mouse, it avoids the ship to keep rotating on the same spot and allow the screen warp. 


Thanks for the feedback on the last update, and please let me know if there's any issue with the game. 

Join our discord server for direct communication.
discord.nukgames.com

notes.title: Cyberhunt Ver. 2.01
Cyberhunt MASSIVE UPDATE.
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/70a6c68e45527e58b17eb9882f1193eaf1382f53.gif
Hello friends, I have been silent for the past few months, and the reason for that is that I was making a huge update to CYBERHUNT, I basically remade it from the ground up. 
 Changed the game engine
 All graphics remade
 New missions system
 Enemies IA remade and added 2 new enemies (tank and missile)
 Controls improved and modernized
 New SFX
 and A LOT MORE... 
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/cc897322bf3be83f5a06389364af52f19618cf1c.gif
In case you prefer, you can also access the original version of CYBERHUNT by selecting the option when launching the game. 

I choose to release this as a update and not as a sequel to thank you all for all the support and give some back to the communty that gave me so much!
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/15171fc99f2047ac411bb1ad47fa1b13a46ea3c8.gif
Please let me know if you enjoyed this update, it took a lot of time and work to make it, maybe I'll do something like this with another of my titles if I feel that you guys liked.

My newest game is on sale right now, for the lowest price EVER, please check it out. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143900/Shapeshooter/
As aways thank you very much for all the support.
Paulo

notes.title: SHAPESHOOTER - Update Ver. 1.01
Polygoneer FREE + Update
notes.content:

Hello friends, with giveaway of POLYGONEER the playerbase of the game has grown exponentially and some of the new players reported dificulties to play the game with different keyboard layouts. So I updated the game following this requests:

notes.title: Razortron 2084 - Devlog #7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34745944/c1989960f2d7b9cf5c748fc05c22ed041b6f0adb.gif

Hello friends, for this devlog I would like to highlight the Pseudo 3D buildings that I managed to develop for Razortron 2084, with this I'll be able to make much preetier and more diverse scenarios, you  can see on the gif above, the algorithm turns flat 2d images into pseudo 3D images. I also changed a litte bit the art direction on the game, to be more 'texturized' (what do you think about this) It can be seen better on the first screenshot on the game's page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052650/Razortron_2084/
(add to your wishlist and follow to receive updates on the development)

Some other things that I finished or are almost done
- Traffic IA
- Traffic and road generation for the arcade mode
- In-game color switch (this is usefull to come with cool color schemes)
- Joystick Support.

Now the things are moving much faster and I'll announce more features on the future weeks. 

Thank you very much for all the support, friends

Paulo Brunassi
NukGames

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Razortron sequel
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/a19c40547524e6880d95a36d08af3f2258338ca4.gif

Hello friends, how was your blackfriday?

I'm back with the fourth devlog, and this time the update is preety big:

The skeleton of the first circuit is done (the edges are rough, but will be fixed soon) ;
A basic AI is set(will work a lot on it soon);
A new sprite for the first of the many cars the game will have, this one is bigger so I could put more details into it; 
Completely remade the camera system and I think it's very smooth now, maybe will apply some zoom in and out sometime soon.
Developed a tool to change the neon color ingame, I'll implement it on the final game too.(it can be seen on 45 seconds of the video)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sPi1ToYoRYM&t=3s
Final thoughts
After working for almost two months on the game, the shape and direction of it is much more clear for me, and I think the development speed will increase now.

ps. On this weekend I'll be joining the Ludum Dare, so if you'll like to follow the development please follow me on twitter, after the game is done, I'll post here too.

Thank you very much for all the support I've been receiving during this years, you guys are great!

Paulo Brunassi
Steam Creators Page
Twitter
Instagram
